summary: Social organizations and NGOs worldwide can improve their effectiveness and transparency in working with beneficiaries through this case management software. The offline-first web app is tailored for use in various geographic contexts, including low-income countries and rural areas. The project aims to enhance the lives of vulnerable populations by streamlining work processes and increasing transparency. It addresses the social sector, focusing on community development and social welfare. The software is designed to be used by non-governmental organizations, governments, and other social organizations.
